mapping_profile.ownership_rule: This file maps aerospace domain identities into the generic BASALT timeline. It is not a timeline, evidence ledger, qualification authority, or physical source of truth.

resource_classes.digest_rule: Pin the authoritative immutable material specification/revision artifact or content commitment.
Use the verified lot/traveler packet content commitment; a lot label is not a digest.
Pin the exact controlled recipe/process revision and applicable process window.
Pin the exact build/process execution packet and its verified artifact commitment.
Identity and state are bound to an exact equipment/site record; a display name is insufficient.
Pin the exact manufactured unit/detail revision and its source genealogy.

resource_classes.owner: specimen traveler and sampling record; independent of inferred hierarchy
resource_classes.digest_rule: Pin the independent specimen source assertion and sampling event; hierarchy-derived identity alone is not an independent witness.
Pin exact product-definition revision and the independent specimen/intended-configuration assertion.
Pin method/revision, campaign protocol and the exact test execution record.
Pin instrument identity, calibration certificate/event, validity interval and any revocation or correction event.

resource_classes.owner: inspection authority and NDE equipment/metrology records
resource_classes.digest_rule: Pin procedure revision, equipment identity, calibration, coverage and demonstrated detectability scope.

resource_classes.owner: engineering analysis configuration and source/toolchain owner
resource_classes.digest_rule: Pin model source, solver/version, executable, parameters, mesh and boundary-condition artifacts separately where each can affect the claim.
Pin exact mesh and boundary-condition artifacts, including coordinate frames and load/environment state.
Reuse packet artifact SHA-256 and byte length; do not create a second artifact ledger.
Pin the exact declared environment/mission scenario revision; no implication of field representativeness.

evidence_classes.notes: Evidence digest refers to the actual report/record artifact. A parseable or signed report is not proof of physical measurement truth.
The test unit, group hierarchy and uncertainty provenance must remain available through the supporting packet/claim closure.
A model verification/validation result and a physical test result are distinct evidence classes.
Coverage, probability of detection, threshold of detection and applicability are separate claims.
This is a closure/analysis evidence record, not an approval or airworthiness certificate.
Keep battery, propulsion, thermal and reserve claims separately scoped and linked through exact dependencies.

change_kind_mapping.domain_change: material lot/source/grade/specification, process recipe/window, batch, machine/tooling/site, specimen identity, calibration, test method, inspection method, NDE equipment, evidence correction/revocation
product definition, geometry, layup/configuration, mesh or boundary-condition configuration
analysis source, solver implementation or model implementation source
compiler, solver runtime, external analysis toolchain

mapping_invariants: resource_id is stable logical identity; digest is exact content/state identity; generation is BASALT-owned monotonic resource history.
Never derive a digest from a human-readable identifier or a mutable label.
Never create resource pins from an inferred or unresolved identity.

Never emit dependency_coverage=complete unless the applicable observer profile is independently qualified for every relevant input channel; otherwise emit incomplete/unresolved and retain the affected evidence as ineligible.
Map evidence_dependencies only to already recorded upstream evidence IDs, preserving the evidence DAG; typed claim-support closure remains in the existing CEB/engineering claim representation.
Do not create domain-specific invalidation algorithms or a second append-only qualification lifecycle.
A change to an independent source assertion or certificate revocation is an event even when a physical value or content label is unchanged.
BASALT freshness is not physical truth; ASSURE lifecycle currentness is not engineering correctness; neither grants approval or execution authority.
